row.proto: void Game_CustomisationReplicationManager_SendDataMessage(void *self, uint32_t *peer, void *identity, void *data_pair, uint8_t reliable, int32_t *kind)
row.notes: Copies two optional customisation blocks from data_pair (+0x20.. and +0x140.., each with optional slot, optional u32, optional 0x30-slot array and a shared-ptr vector) into locals, then builds a network message with header {7,0xbd} (vtable 0x145827240) when *kind==0 or {7,0xbe} (0x1458272a0) when *kind==1, embedding the 0x44-byte identity from identity+8 and both blocks, and sends it with 0x144030ad0(self+0x38, *peer, msg, 0, reliable). Other kind values send nothing. Good hook to observe outgoing customisation replication.
